releaseNotes:
🚀 Installer Cache Optimization & Direct Cloud Restore (v1.1.6) by Dhiraj:
• 🛑 Fixed Repeated Install Popup: Resolves the issue where Android prompted to install repeatedly even after successfully updating. Obsolete APKs in cache are now automatically purged on install
• 📂 Direct Cloud Backup Opening: Tapping a .enc, .bin, or .msgvault file in Google Drive or cloud storage now directly launches MsgVault to decrypt and restore
• 📤 Cloud Share Sheet Integration: Backup files shared via 'Send a copy' from Google Drive or messaging apps are automatically routed to the restore engine
• 🔍 Universal Cloud Picker: Enhanced Google Drive file browser allowing seamless selection of all backup archives without greyed-out files
